notes: True with the polynomial of degree n+1 (entry offset 0 shifts the index by one: degree n gives a(n-1)). A129756.A129756_roots: (Pp (n+1)).roots.countP (0 < re) = 1 + 2*(n/4); P_count for degree n >= 1: 1 + 2*((n-1)/4); A083219_roots: left half-plane count n - 2*(n/4). Proof: Q = (X-1)P = X^(n+1) - 2X^n + 1; Im/Re Q(iy) explicit by n mod 4, so Q(iy) stays in the slit plane; arg Q(iy) minus the sum of explicit arctan arguments of the factors iy - r is constant (2*pi*Z valued); limits Y -> oo give pi(N_L - N_R), quadrant of Q(iY) plus parity fix N_R. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (the index shift is a reading choice; PARI check degrees 1..120 in certificate).
